t1.text: What each customer costs us — office-only, on their invoice

s1.text: Volumes are Gesheft's REAL Aug 3 – Sep 3 numbers from our call log and chat table (11,036 inbound min, 8,759 outbound, 783 texts, 5,375 named inbound calls). The rates and the service costs are illustrative until the carrier feeds are wired and Izzy confirms the Telocall rate. The customer never sees any of this: the card is not in the PDF, the email, or the customer portal.

s2.text: Three honesty tiers on every line — Carrier CDR (their per-call record), Our minutes × rate (Telocall has no API), Estimated (we metered it, priced at list). Outbound goes over the shared 0001 trunk, so it can only ever be our minutes × the Telocall rate unless Telocall gives us an export.
